Notes and Footnotes (ANSI/AWC SDPWS Table 4.2C - Unblocked Wood Structural Panel Diaphragms):

1. Nominal unit shear capacities (vs for Seismic and vw for Wind) shall be adjusted per Section 4.2.3: ASD allowable unit shear v_ASD = v_nominal / 2.0 (Omega = 2.0); LRFD factored unit resistance phi * v_n = 0.80 * v_nominal (phi_D = 0.80).

2. Tabulated values are based on 6 in. o.c. nail spacing at diaphragm boundaries and all supported panel edges, and 12 in. o.c. along intermediate framing members (6 in. o.c. where framing is spaced >= 48 in. o.c.).

3. Nominal unit shear capacities apply to Douglas Fir-Larch (G = 0.50) or Southern Pine (G = 0.55) framing. For species with G < 0.50, multiply nominal unit shear capacity by C_sp = 1 - (0.5 - G) <= 1.0.

4. Case 1 applies where load is perpendicular to unblocked edges and continuous panel joints (staggered unblocked edges). Cases 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 apply where load is parallel to unblocked edges or continuous panel joints.
